steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: At this point... we're out of other options. Madam Ch'en, if you deny my request...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Rhodes Island will act alone.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: These actions don't violate any of the terms of our cooperation.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Of course we'll be there.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Is that so...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: In that case, thank you on behalf of Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I know that Lungmen still sees us as Infected...

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It's not a big deal.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: However, I'm not sure if our squads will be able to make it into the ruins.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We'll have to play it by ear.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: If the situation allows, we will definitely help.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: However, our top priority is still to eliminate Reunion.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: That... that's enough for us.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: ...Thank you, Madam Ch'en.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Sorry, I have my own duties.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Did you hear me, Doc?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: We will join up with Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya, be careful.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This won't be a simple task.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Right, I've managed to put together some pieces of intel.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Rhodes Island has already deployed rescue squads to assist the other recon squads.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But Meteorite's squad is too far and we cannot reach them.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: This is where you come in.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Only Meteorite's squad...

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: I understand. I'll go look for them.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I'll send you the coordinates later.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Remember, safety is your top priority.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: So, when are we heading out?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Right now.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'll go get ready. Notify the other L.G.D. members.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: All right.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Amiya, we'll leave from here in ten minutes.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Okay.

steps.name: Amiya
steps.text: Please be safe...
